# fix(hfp-013): analysis started twice before the model is ready

## Task

Calling `analyzeSegments` again before `MODELS_READY` arrives (`src/stores/useResearchStore.ts`) causes, without any error:
- the first call's segments are lost, because `pendingSegments` holds one array and is overwritten;
- `LOAD_MODELS` is posted again, because `modelsReady` is still false. The worker's `onmessage` is async, so both `pipeline()` loads run at once: two copies of the model in memory, `llm` overwritten by whichever finishes last, and two `PROGRESS` streams interleaved (the progress bar can jump backwards);
- the second `MODELS_READY` finds `pendingSegments` empty and does nothing;
- the second call's `projectName` is ignored.

Mock mode hides it. It can't happen in the UI today, but it will once transcript upload (HFP-011) exists.

## Parent Story

Analysis re-entry bug (found 2026-11-05, `notes/task-list.md`).

## Blocked by

- HFP-012 (where the concurrent-call behaviour is decided)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Model loading is tracked separately from "ready" (e.g. a `loading | ready` state or one shared load promise), so `LOAD_MODELS` is sent at most once per worker.
- [ ] A second call while analysis is pending or running behaves as HFP-012 decided. Neither call's segments are silently dropped.
- [ ] Spec: two `analyzeSegments` calls before `MODELS_READY` → exactly one `LOAD_MODELS` posted, and both sets of segments have the defined outcome.

## Suggested label

`ready-for-agent` (once HFP-012 is done)
